_comment: Configuration paths the drivers spell that the schema and the menu manifest do not declare as properties: tables whose children are dynamic (one key per shortcut slot or binding) and the tap-hold timing leaves the Karabiner generator reads. They join the generated KEY table (tools/codegen/codegen-config-keys.cjs), so code names them by constant. Add a path here only when code reads or writes it and no schema property or manifest row does.
